question: As per the Economic Survey 2020–21, net FPI (Foreign Portfolio Investment) recorded an all-time monthly high of US$9.8 billion in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**November 2020**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• With global asset shifts towards equities and prospects of a faster recovery in emerging economies, India remained a preferred foreign investment destination in FY21, with Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) pouring in.
 
• As risk appetite began to recover, net FPI (Foreign Portfolio Investments) inflows reached an all-time monthly high of US$9.8 billion in November 2020.
 
• Furthermore, in 2020, India was the only major economy to attract equity Foreign Institutional Investments (FII).
 
• The economy's liquidity condition is solid, and the stock market has reached previously inconceivable heights in recent months.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Securities and other financial assets held by investors in another nation are referred to as** foreign portfolio investments (FPI).**
 
• It does not provide the investor's actual ownership of a company's assets and, depending on market volatility, is relatively liquid.
